cards.name: Layer
cards.summary: Deletes the selected layer from the document, along with its masks and layer style. Run from the menu, Photoshop first asks you to confirm the deletion. The harvest saw it enabled whenever one layer was selected and disabled in its multi-layer state. Needs an open document.
cards.how: A confirmation alert ('Delete the layer ...?') appears unless it was switched off earlier. Hidden layers have their own item, Layer/Delete/Hidden Layers.
use_for: removing a discarded draft headline or an unused photo layer from a poster file
cleaning stray empty layers out of a template before handing it over
avoid: hiding something you may need again: use Layer/Hide Layers or a layer mask instead
removing only part of a layer: make a selection and press Delete, or mask it

cards.name: Bottom Edges
cards.summary: Moves the selected layers vertically so that their bottom edges are evenly spaced. The two layers whose bottom edges are highest and lowest stay where they are and the ones between are moved. Needs three or more layers selected. The harvest found it disabled in every state with fewer layers and ran it on a three-layer fixture.
use_for: spacing a vertical stack of product shots or icons of different heights so their baselines step evenly
evenly spacing rows of price tags that share a bottom alignment
avoid: equal gaps between objects of different heights: use Layer/Distribute/Vertically
lining layers up on one edge: use Layer/Align/Bottom Edges

review.changes: summary: the fixed layers are the ones with the outermost edge/centre being distributed, not simply the outermost layers (a wide layer can differ)

cards.name: Horizontally
cards.summary: Spaces the selected layers horizontally so that the gaps between neighbouring layers are equal (distribute spacing). It measures the empty space between the layers' bounding boxes instead of lining up edges or centres, and the leftmost and rightmost layers stay fixed. Needs three or more layers selected. The harvest found it disabled with fewer layers and ran it on a three-layer fixture.
use_for: equal gutters between product cards or buttons of different widths in a web banner
evenly spaced row of team photos or badges on a poster
avoid: a fixed gap in pixels: Photoshop's distribute takes no spacing value (it only shares the space between the outermost layers) and has no Align panel; set each layer's X/Y in the Properties panel instead
evenly spacing centres of same-size items: Layer/Distribute/Horizontal Centers gives the same result and is clearer

cards.name: Duplicate Layer
cards.summary: Makes a copy of the selected layer, or several selected layers, with its masks and style. The copy is placed directly above the original in the current document, or sent to another open document or a new one. The harvest ran it and saw 'px1' turn into 'px1' plus 'px1 copy'. Needs an open document.
cards.how: The dialog sets the copy's name in As. Destination Document chooses the current file, another open file or New, which creates a document from the layer. When the destination is New, it can also be given a document name. Artboard picks the target artboard when the file has artboards.
use_for: keeping an untouched copy of a photo layer before retouching or applying a filter
moving a finished logo or graphic layer into another open campaign file
starting a variant of a headline treatment next to the original
avoid: building a non-destructive edit stack: a Smart Object or adjustment layer is lighter than many pixel copies
copying only a selected area: use Layer/New/Layer Via Copy (Ctrl+J with a selection)

DOM alternative (unverified): app.activeDocument.activeLayer.duplicate().

review.changes: avoid: path spelled as harvested (Layer/New/Layer Via Copy, Ctrl+J from its kys entry)

cards.name: Export As
cards.summary: Opens the Export As dialog for the selected layers, so that each selected layer is saved as its own image file (PNG, JPG or GIF), cropped to its content, with size and scale options. Needs an open document. The harvest skipped running it because it exports files.
cards.how: Each selected layer appears as an asset on the left. You set the format (PNG with transparency, JPG quality, GIF), the image size and scale (several scale versions with file-name suffixes for screen densities), the canvas size, metadata and the colour-space conversion to sRGB. Then click Export and choose a folder.
use_for: exporting the separate graphics of a social or web layout (icons, buttons, cut-out product shots) as PNG assets
delivering the same UI element at several scales (with suffixed file names) to a developer
pulling one transparent cut-out out of a composite without flattening
avoid: exporting the whole canvas as one image: use File > Export > Export As or Quick Export
print output: Export As is screen-oriented (sRGB, pixel sizes); save a PDF or TIFF instead
cards.script_api: No script route harvested: export commands were skipped by rule. Without the dialog (unverified): duplicate each layer into a new document (layer.duplicate(newDoc)), trim it, then call doc.saveAs(file, new PNGSaveOptions(), true) or doc.exportDocument(file, ExportType.SAVEFORWEB, opts).

review.changes: how/use_for: removed scale values (0.5x/1x/2x/3x) that are not in the batch

cards.name: Flatten Image
cards.summary: Merges every visible layer into a single Background layer. Hidden layers are discarded after a prompt, and transparent areas are filled with white. Layer styles, adjustment layers, type and Smart Objects are baked into pixels. The harvest saw 2 layers become 1 Background. Needs an open document.
cards.how: If any layers are hidden, Photoshop asks whether to discard them first.
use_for: making a final single-layer JPG or TIFF for print or a client who cannot open layered files
reducing file size before sending a finished poster to a printer that wants a flat file
avoid: any file you may still edit: save a layered PSD first, or flatten a copy made with Image/Duplicate and keep the original layered
artwork that needs transparency: flattening fills it with white; export a PNG instead
cards.script_api: executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('flattenImage'), new ActionDescriptor(), DialogModes.NO); verified live (layers 2 -> 1 Background, history 'Flatten Image'). DOM alternative (unverified): app.activeDocument.flatten().

cards.name: Group Layers
cards.summary: Puts the selected layers into a new layer group (a folder in the Layers panel), named 'Group 1' with Pass Through blending, so they can be moved, hidden, masked or styled together. The harvest saw the group created around the selected layer. Needs an open document.
use_for: keeping the headline, subhead and logo of a poster together so they move as one block
organising a multi-section web or social layout into named groups for handover
applying one mask or adjustment to a set of layers via the group
avoid: merging layers into one: use Layer > Merge Layers
a reusable linked graphic: convert to a Smart Object instead
cards.script_api: executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('make'), desc, DialogModes.NO) with desc: null = class layerSection, From = reference to the target layer(s); verified live (history 'Create Group from Layers'). DOM alternative (unverified): app.activeDocument.layerSets.add() and move the layers into it.

cards.name: Harmonize
cards.summary: A generative AI (Firefly) command. It adjusts the colour, lighting and shadows of a placed object layer so that it blends with the background beneath it, and returns generated variations as a new layer. It uses generative credits and needs an online connection. It also needs an object layer with transparency above a background. The harvest found it disabled in every scratch state and did not run it, because it spends credits. Details come from knowledge of the app, not observation.
cards.how: Select the cut-out object layer that sits above the background, choose Layer > Harmonize, then pick one of the variations offered in the Properties panel. The result arrives as a new generative layer, and the original stays intact.
use_for: blending a cut-out product shot into a lifestyle background for an ad or social post
matching the lighting of a person composited into a new scene for a poster
quickly unifying the colour of collage elements
avoid: offline, credit-limited or confidential work: it sends the image to Adobe's servers and spends credits
exact, repeatable colour matching: use Curves or Color Balance adjustment layers clipped to the object, or Image/Adjustments/Match Color (destructive, no adjustment-layer form)
cards.script_api: No script route harvested (generative commands were not run because they spend credits).

review.changes: avoid: Match Color has no adjustment-layer form in the harvest (Image/Adjustments only); reworded

cards.name: Hide Layers
cards.summary: Turns off the visibility (eye icon) of the selected layers without deleting them. When the selected layers are hidden, the item becomes Show Layers. The harvest saw the layer's visible flag go from v to h. Needs an open document.
use_for: comparing a layout with and without a graphic or retouch layer
keeping alternate headline or colour versions in one file and showing one at a time
hiding guides-only or reference layers before export
avoid: removing content for good: use Layer/Delete/Layer
hiding part of a layer: use a layer mask (Layer/Layer Mask)
cards.script_api: executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('hide'), desc, DialogModes.NO) with desc: null = list of references to the target layers; verified live (layer visibility v -> h). DOM alternative (unverified): app.activeDocument.activeLayer.visible = false.

cards.name: Layer Content Options
cards.summary: Reopens the settings of the selected fill or adjustment layer so you can change them. A Solid Color fill layer gets its Color Picker (Solid Color), as observed in the harvest. Gradient and Pattern fills get their fill dialogs, and adjustment layers get their Properties panel. Needs a fill or adjustment layer selected; the item was disabled on plain pixel layers.
cards.how: The dialog shown depends on the layer type: for Solid Color, the colour picker; for Gradient Fill, the gradient, style, angle, scale and method; for Pattern Fill, the pattern, angle and scale; for adjustment layers, their Properties controls.
use_for: changing the colour of a solid-colour background or overlay layer in a template
re-editing a gradient overlay on a poster
tweaking an adjustment layer's settings from a menu or action
avoid: pixel or type layers: nothing to edit here; use the layer's own tools
quicker editing by hand: double-click the layer thumbnail in the Layers panel
cards.script_api: app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('adjustmentOptions')); verified live, it opens the content dialog (Color Picker (Solid Color) on a Solid Color layer). To change the content without the dialog (unverified): executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('set'), desc, DialogModes.NO) with null = reference to the target contentLayer, to = solidColorLayer { color: RGBColor }.

cards.name: Apply
cards.summary: Bakes the selected layer's layer mask into the layer itself: the masked-out pixels become transparent or are deleted, and the mask is removed. The harvest saw the 'um' (user mask) flag disappear, with history 'Apply Layer Mask'. Needs a layer that has a layer mask.
use_for: finalising a cut-out product or portrait before exporting it as a transparent PNG
reducing layer complexity in a finished file handed to another app
avoid: any cut-out you may still refine: keep the mask live (non-destructive)
Smart Objects: the mask cannot be applied into them; rasterise first or keep the mask

cards.name: Delete
cards.summary: Removes the selected layer's layer mask and throws it away, so that the whole layer is visible again; the layer's pixels are not changed. The harvest saw the 'um' flag removed, with history 'Delete Layer Mask'. Needs a layer that has a layer mask.
use_for: starting a cut-out mask over from scratch
removing an unwanted mask from a template layer
avoid: keeping the masked result: use Layer/Layer Mask/Apply
temporarily seeing the full layer: use Layer/Layer Mask/Enable (disable) instead of deleting
cards.script_api: executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('delete'), desc, DialogModes.NO) with desc: null = reference to the mask channel (Chnl, Chnl, Msk ); verified live (history 'Delete Layer Mask').

cards.name: Enable
cards.summary: Toggles the selected layer's mask off and on without deleting it. While the mask is active the item reads Disable, a disabled mask shows a red X in the Layers panel, and the full layer is visible. The harvest ran the disable direction (userMaskEnabled false, history 'Disable Layer Mask'). Needs a layer that has a layer mask.
use_for: checking a cut-out against the unmasked original while refining a mask
temporarily showing a masked-out area of a composite to a client

cards.name: From Transparency
cards.summary: Adds a layer mask built from the selected layer's own transparency, so that the layer's see-through areas are defined by an editable mask: white where the layer was opaque, dark where it was transparent. As far as is known the layer's pixels are made opaque so that the mask alone controls visibility; the harvest only confirmed that a mask was added. Enabled on plain pixel layers but not on type, Smart Object or group layers.
use_for: turning an image with an alpha channel (a PNG cut-out) into a layer plus an editable mask for refinement
softening or repainting the edge of a transparent cut-out with brushes on its mask
avoid: type, Smart Object or group layers: the item is disabled; use Reveal All or Reveal Selection
a mask from a selection you drew: use Layer/Layer Mask/Reveal Selection
cards.script_api: executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('make'), desc, DialogModes.NO) with desc: new = class channel, at = reference to the mask channel, using = enumerated userMaskEnabled 'transparent'; verified live (mask flag added, history 'Add Layer Mask').

cards.name: Hide All
cards.summary: Adds a black (fully hiding) layer mask to the selected layer, so the whole layer disappears until you paint white on the mask to reveal parts of it. The harvest saw the mask added and the visible bounds become 0,0,0,0. Needs an open document and a layer without a mask.
use_for: painting in a texture, light leak or second exposure only where wanted
revealing a retouch or sharpening layer selectively with a soft brush
avoid: masks that start from a selection: use Layer/Layer Mask/Hide Selection or Reveal Selection
starting with everything visible: use Layer/Layer Mask/Reveal All
cards.script_api: executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('make'), desc, DialogModes.NO) with desc: new = class channel, at = reference to the mask channel, using = enumerated userMaskEnabled 'hideAll'; verified live (history 'Add Layer Mask').

cards.name: Hide Selection
cards.summary: Adds a layer mask that hides the area inside the current selection (black inside, white outside), knocking that area out of the layer non-destructively. Needs an active selection; the harvest found it enabled only in the selection state.
use_for: cutting a window or shape out of a photo or colour block so the layer below shows through
removing a background area you selected while keeping it recoverable
avoid: keeping the selected area and hiding the rest: use Layer/Layer Mask/Reveal Selection

cards.name: Link
cards.summary: Toggles the link between the selected layer and its layer mask. While they are linked (the default, a chain icon in the Layers panel) the item reads Unlink, and the two move and transform together. Once unlinked, the layer content can be moved or scaled inside a fixed mask, or the reverse. The harvest ran the unlink direction (userMaskLinked false, history 'Unlink Mask'). Needs a layer that has a layer mask.
use_for: repositioning or scaling a photo inside a fixed frame-shaped mask on a poster or social template
moving a vignette or reveal mask without moving the image
avoid: forgetting to relink before moving the whole element: layer and mask drift apart

cards.name: Reveal All
cards.summary: Adds a white (fully revealing) layer mask to the selected layer. Nothing changes visibly, but you can then paint black on the mask to hide parts of the layer non-destructively. The harvest saw the mask added with the layer still fully visible. Needs an open document and a layer without a mask.
use_for: blending two photos together with a soft black brush on the mask
hiding parts of a texture or adjustment without erasing pixels
fading the edge of an image into the background with a gradient on the mask
avoid: hiding most of the layer: start from Layer/Layer Mask/Hide All
a precise shape: make a selection and use Reveal Selection

cards.name: Reveal Selection
cards.summary: Adds a layer mask that shows the layer only inside the current selection (white inside, black outside), giving a non-destructive cut-out. The harvest saw the mask added and the visible bounds shrink to the selection. Needs an active selection.
use_for: cutting out a product or person after Select Subject or Object Selection
placing a photo inside a shape for a poster or social frame
isolating the sky or foreground for a separate adjustment
avoid: hiding the selected area instead: use Layer/Layer Mask/Hide Selection
a crisp vector-edged frame: a vector mask or a clipping mask with a shape layer stays sharper when scaled
cards.script_api: executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('make'), desc, DialogModes.NO) with desc: new = class channel, at = reference to the mask channel, using = enumerated userMaskEnabled 'revealSelection'; verified live on a lasso selection (history 'Add Layer Mask').

cards.name: Blending Options
cards.summary: Opens the Layer Style dialog on its Blending Options page. There you set how the selected layer mixes with the layers below: blend mode, opacity, fill opacity, knockout, channel restrictions and the Blend If sliders, which hide pixels by their brightness. Needs an open document.
cards.how: General Blending: Blend Mode and Opacity. Advanced Blending: Fill Opacity (fades pixels but not effects), Channels R/G/B, Knockout (None/Shallow/Deep), Blend Interior Effects as Group, Blend Clipped Layers as Group, Transparency Shapes Layer, Layer Mask Hides Effects and Vector Mask Hides Effects. Blend If (Gray or a single channel) has This Layer and Underlying Layer sliders; Alt-drag splits a slider for a soft transition.
use_for: dropping the white paper out of a scanned logo or lettering with Blend If
making a text layer's fill invisible while keeping its stroke or glow (Fill Opacity 0)
punching text through to the background with a knockout
avoid: only changing blend mode or opacity: the Layers panel controls are faster
clean cut-outs on photos with complex backgrounds: use a layer mask instead of Blend If
cards.script_api: No script route harvested (no menuItemType or event matches). To set the same options without the dialog (unverified): layer.blendMode, layer.opacity and layer.fillOpacity in the DOM; knockout and Blend If only through an Action Manager 'set' on the layer descriptor.

cards.name: Clear Disabled Layer Styles
cards.summary: Judging by its name and the harvest note, it removes only the layer effects that are switched off (eye icon off) from the selected layer's style and leaves the enabled effects in place. In the harvested Photoshop 2026 this item is hidden from the menu and was disabled in every state tried, so its behaviour was not observed.
use_for: cleaning switched-off effects out of a template's layer styles before handover, so they cannot be re-enabled by accident
avoid: relying on it in automation: no working script route was found
removing all effects: use Layer/Layer Style/Clear Layer Style
cards.script_api: No working route. The harvested candidate executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('disableLayerFX'), new ActionDescriptor(), DialogModes.NO) was tried live and is a different command (Clear Effects): it removed an ENABLED drop shadow. Do not use it for this job.

cards.name: Clear Layer Style
cards.summary: Removes the whole layer style from the selected layers: every effect (drop shadow, stroke, glow, bevel and so on) is deleted at once and the layer returns to its plain look. The harvest saw a drop shadow removed and the layer bounds shrink back to the pixel content. Needs a layer that has a style.
use_for: stripping old effects off a template headline before restyling it
removing heavy bevels and shadows from a client's logo layer
avoid: switching effects off temporarily: toggle their eye icons or Layer > Layer Style > Hide All Effects
removing one effect: drag it to the trash in the Layers panel or untick it in the Layer Style dialog
cards.script_api: executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('disableLayerStyle'), new ActionDescriptor(), DialogModes.NO); verified live (fx flag fx -> fxoff, history 'Clear Layer Style').

cards.name: Copy Layer Style
cards.summary: Copies the selected layer's style (its effects and blending options) to the style clipboard, so it can be pasted onto other layers with Paste Layer Style. Nothing changes on the canvas. Needs a layer that has a style.
use_for: applying the same stroke, shadow and glow to every headline on a carousel or poster series
copying a button style to other button layers in a UI mock-up
avoid: styles reused across many files: save the style to the Styles panel instead
copying to layers of very different size: scale the effects after pasting (Layer Style > Scale Effects)
cards.script_api: executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('copyEffects'), new ActionDescriptor(), DialogModes.NO); ran live (history 'Copy Style'), though the harvest's follow-up check returned 'General Photoshop error'. Paste onto the target with executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('pasteEffects'), ...) (unverified).

cards.name: Create Layer
cards.summary: Converts the selected layer's effects into separate ordinary pixel layers, for example a layer called "Layer 1's Drop Shadow" clipped or stacked next to the original. The effects can then be painted, warped or masked, but are no longer live and editable. Photoshop may warn that some aspects of the effects cannot be reproduced with layers. Needs a layer that has a style.
cards.how: No settings. When an effect cannot be reproduced exactly, an alert appears that has to be confirmed.
use_for: warping or partially erasing a drop shadow so it falls naturally on a product shot
handing a styled headline to an app or printer that does not support layer styles
avoid: styles you may still edit: duplicate the layer first or keep the live style
exact visual fidelity with complex effects: the warning means the result can differ; check it
cards.script_api: No verified route. Candidate, NOT confirmed: executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('make'), desc, ...) with desc: null = class layer, Usng = reference to the target layer's layerEffects property. Tried live, it raised an untitled 'Adobe Photoshop' dialog and no result was observed.

review.changes: scriptable partial -> no: the batch's only candidate (make, Usng = layerEffects) was not confirmed and stopped on an untitled 'Adobe Photoshop' dialog; confidence high -> medium since the command was never observed working
